title: Free agent Bohm reaches 2-year deal with Royals, reports say
summary: Free agent third baseman Alec Bohm has agreed to a two-year deal with Kansas City, according to multiple reports.

title: Source: Marlins agree to 1-year deal with catcher Sanchez
summary: The Miami Marlins are in agreement on a one-year, $6.5 million contract with catcher Gary Sanchez, a source told ESPN.

title: Sources: Tigers stay busy, reach 1-year, $25M deal with RHP Gausman
summary: RHP Kevin Gausman and the Tigers have agreed to a one-year, $25M contract, pending a physical, sources told ESPN's Jeff Passan on Wednesday.

title: Mets brass 'thrilled' to have Skubal in rotation for 'years to come'
summary: Tarik Skubal, a two-time Cy Young Award winner, has finalized a record $450 million, nine-year contract with the New York Mets.

title: Sources: Rockies adding Peterson, Sandoval to revamped staff
summary: The Rockies agreed to a two-year, $32 million deal with David Peterson and a three-year, $42 million deal with Patrick Sandoval, sources told ESPN.

title: Sources: Orioles to bring OF Robert back on 1-year deal
summary: The Baltimore Orioles are in agreement with OF Luis Robert Jr. on a one-year, $12 million deal, sources told ESPN.

title: Reports: Guardians bring back Griffin on $48 million, 3-year deal
summary: Pitcher Foster Griffin will return to the Cleveland Guardians after agreeing to a three-year, $48 million contract, according to multiple reports.

title: Sources: Twins, reliever Ginkel agree to 2-year, $18 million deal
summary: The Twins and former Diamondbacks reliever Kevin Ginkel have agreed to a two-year, $18 million contract, sources confirmed to ESPN.
